headline: Foreigners Bet on 'Leverage,' Individuals on 'Inverse Leveraged ETFs'; Who Wins?
summary: Foreigners have been betting on leveraged products and individuals on inverse leveraged ETFs this month. The KOSPI 200 is up 5% this month, with leveraged funds outperforming inverse ETFs.
why: The KOSPI 200 is South Korea's benchmark large-cap index, and shifts in foreign and retail positioning can signal changing market sentiment.

impacts.name: KOSPI 200
impacts.why: The report says the KOSPI 200 rose 5% this month, with positioning split between leveraged and inverse products.
